transcript.text: Alright everyone, thanks for gathering. As we prepare to finalize the format for Saturday's showcase, I need to hear from each of you on any constraints that could impact the final show structure. Digital team, labor team, artist team — please report anything that affects scheduling, staging, technical requirements, or talent availability so I can approve the format and we can lock in the production schedule.
